summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1, and validated persistence across a real node restart. Config written to /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route = 0 for all/default), applied at runtime including to the live enp1s0 interface. node1 was then rebooted via systemctl reboot; boot_id changed from bccb87ac-2704-41fb-ab29-fb36e0053c13 to 242efcb7-4043-48e9-bc22-e109c236060c, proving an actual restart. Post-reboot verification confirmed all/default and enp1s0 sysctls remained 0. Loopback's accept_redirects reset to 1 due to kernel init ordering (lo is created before sysctl.d applies) — not security-relevant since redirects don't apply meaningfully to lo — and was re-set to 0 for completeness.
actions_performed: Captured baseline boot_id and pre-change sysctl values on node1
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf disabling accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for all/default
Applied config at runtime with sysctl --system
Verified per-interface (enp1s0, lo) values, found stale enp1s0 accept_redirects=1, fixed by setting all live interfaces directly
Captured pre-restart healthy baseline: boot_id, sysctl.d file contents, systemctl is-system-running, ip addr
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Verified post-reboot sysctl persistence and system health with new boot_id

evidence.summary: Captured pre-change sysctl values, boot_id bccb87ac-2704-41fb-ab29-fb36e0053c13, systemctl is-system-running=running, and interface state before rebooting.
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf disabling accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route for all/default.

evidence.requirement: Configuration applied and effective at runtime
evidence.summary: Applied via sysctl --system, verified per-interface state, corrected stale enp1s0 value so all live interfaces show accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0.
systemctl reboot issued on node1; command returned before the connection dropped, confirming the restart was triggered.

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Polled node1 until reachable; boot_id changed from bccb87ac-2704-41fb-ab29-fb36e0053c13 to 242efcb7-4043-48e9-bc22-e109c236060c, proving a real reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of hardening settings
evidence.summary: Post-reboot sysctl values for all/default/enp1s0 remained 0 (persisted via sysctl.d), system reported running/healthy with network connectivity restored; lo interface's accept_redirects re-applied to 0 for completeness.
